# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in repo-intel, please report it responsibly.

**Do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

### How to Report

Use [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/sumsankar/repo-intel/security/advisories/new) to submit details confidentially.

Include in your report:
- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce or proof-of-concept
- Any suggested mitigation

### Response Timeline

| Step | Target |
|------|--------|
| Acknowledgement | Within 48 hours |
| Initial assessment | Within 5 business days |
| Resolution / patch | Within 30 days (critical), 90 days (others) |

We appreciate responsible disclosure and will credit researchers in the advisory once resolved.
